correctness.rationale: Set r=n(1-alpha). When r<1 VaR and integrated-quantile ES equal the sample maximum; at r=1 this formula transitions correctly. For 1<=r<2 VaR=L_(n-1) and ES=((r-1)L_(n-1)+L_n)/r; at fixed maximum ES is nondecreasing in VaR (strict for r>1), so strict opposite rankings are impossible. At the first feasible integer n*=ceil(2/(1-alpha)), 2<=r<3 and VaR is third-largest; witnesses A=(0,...,0,1,3,4), B=(0,...,0,2,2,4) share total 8 and max 4 while VaR(A)=1<2=VaR(B) but ES(A)-ES(B)=(3-r)/r>0. Own exact rational computations verify representative alpha including 0.95,0.975; algebra proves arbitrary alpha.
